# Pesher Psalms Column 5 — The EMET Bible (Literal)
**Translator:** EMET | **Source:** 4QpPs (4Q171), Col. 5 | **Condition:** heavily fragmentary

---

**5:1** [...] "I have seen the wicked-one in great power, spreading-himself like a green tree

**5:2** in its native soil; yet he passed away, and behold, he was no more" (Psalm 37:35-36).

**5:3** Its pesher concerns the Man of the [Lie...] who spread himself [...] against

**5:4** the elect-ones of God [...] and he sought to bring to an end [...]

**5:5** [...] in wickedness, but God [...].

**5:6** [...] "Mark the blameless-one and observe the upright-one, for there is a future

**5:7** for the man of peace" (Psalm 37:37).

**5:8** Its pesher concerns [...] the congregation of His chosen-ones

**5:9** who do His will [...] and they shall be [...]

**5:10** [...] peace without end.

**5:11** "[...the transgressors shall be destroyed together]; the future of the wicked-ones

**5:12** shall be cut off" (Psalm 37:38).

**5:13** Its pesher concerns [...] the congregation of the seekers of smooth-things who are in Jerusalem,

**5:14** [...] whose deeds are evil [...] who will perish

**5:15** from the midst of the congregation of the community.

**5:16** [...] for great is [...] the judgment of God [...].

**5:17** [...] the end [...].

---

*EMET notes: Translated from 4Q171 Col. 5. "Man of the Lie" (ish ha-kazav) recurs from Col. 1 — the community's internal adversary. "Seekers of smooth-things" (dorshei ha-chalaqot) — a key Qumran epithet, likely for the Pharisees who "seek smooth/easy interpretations" of Torah. "Elect-ones of God" (bechirei El) preserved as literal compound. The column concludes the pesher on Psalm 37 and may have continued with Psalm 45 material now lost.*
